_comment: Shown in manager only while listed here and not past expiresAt. Fields: id (unique, never reused - a dismissal is remembered by id), severity (INFO, WARNING or CRITICAL), title, message, appIds (empty = shown on Home, otherwise on those apps' pages and on Home), actionAppId (optional catalog app to open, e.g. a temporary alternative), expiresAt (ISO 8601, optional), dismissible (default true), minManagerVersionCode / maxManagerVersionCode (optional).

announcements.title: A "Checks failed" warning is expected
announcements.message: The first two times you open this app, ReVanced may warn that it wasn't patched on this phone. That's because it was built for you ahead of time - App Manager already checks that every download is the genuine build. Wait a few seconds for Ignore to appear, then tap it.
